blocks.content: The Search Committee shall prepare a panel of persons to be considered by the Selection Committee for appointment as the Chairperson and Members of the Lokpal.

rows: Shortlists candidates and prepares a recommended panel
Makes final selections for appointment by the President
At least 8 members with domain expertise
5 members: PM (Chair), Speaker, LoP, CJI/Nominee, Eminent Jurist
No explicit demographic quota prescribed in the Act

items: Minimum 50% membership of the Search Committee must be reserved for SCs, STs, OBCs, Minorities, and Women.
The Selection Committee is not strictly bound by the panel recommended by the Search Committee and can appoint persons outside it.
The Search Committee is constituted by the Selection Committee, which is headed by the Prime Minister.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Search Committee is constituted by the Selection Committee under the Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013.
It comprises at least eight members with expertise in anti-corruption policy, public administration, law, finance, and management.
At least 50% of the Search Committee members must belong to SCs, STs, OBCs, Minorities, and Women.
The primary mandate of the Search Committee is to prepare a panel of candidates for the Chairperson and Members of the Lokpal.
The Selection Committee retains the power to consider candidates outside the panel recommended by the Search Committee.
